sections.facts: The respondent had made an application under section 153 C of the Companies Act, 1913, with an alternative prayer for winding up against the appellant company, to the District Judge, Poona, who had been authorised under the Act to exercise jurisdiction. While the application was pending the Companies Act, 1913, was repealed by the Companies Act, 1956. The appellant company thereupon applied to the District Judge to dismiss the application on the ground that he had ceased to have any jurisdiction to deal with the application on the repeal of the Act of 1913.
sections.statute: Section 6 of the General Clauses Act preserved the jurisdiction of the District Judge to deal with the application under section 153 C of the Indian Companies Act of 1913, notwithstanding the repeal of that Act. Section 647 of the Companies Act, 1956 did not indicate any intention to affect the rights under the Indian Companies Act of 1913, for section 658 of the Companies Act of 1956 made section 6 of the General Clauses Act applicable notwithstanding anything contained in section 647 of that Act.
sections.argument: The appellant company applied to the District Judge to dismiss the application on the ground that he had ceased to have any jurisdiction to deal with the application on the repeal of the Act of 1913.
sections.analysis: Section 24 of the General Clauses Act does not put an end to any notification. It does not therefore cancel the notification issued under the Indian Companies Act of 1913 in so far as that notification empowered the District Judge to exercise jurisdiction under section 153 C of the Indian Companies Act of 1913 even though under section 10 of the Companies Act of 1956, a District Judge can no longer be empowered to exercise jurisdiction under (a) sections 397 to 407 of the Companies Act, 1956, which correspond to section 153 C of the Indian Companies Act, 1913 or (b) in respect of the winding up of a company with a paid up share capital of not less than Rs. 1,00,000, which the appellant company was.
sections.judgement: The appeal was dismissed with costs.
